name: Conesa (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a black embattled wall with two towers, masoned in white, with a red patriarchal cross above.
history: The official flag of Conesa is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white with the black wall of two open towers of the arms, masoned white, at the centre, and the red patriarchal cross patty of the arms above; approved on 21 November 2000 and published in the DOGC on 13 December 2000.

features.role: embattled wall with two open towers, masoned white
patriarchal cross patty above the wall
